verdict.rationale: The Needle README says the same model returns a vector for a sentence so an app can search, match and route locally. That is a first-party, on-device embedding capability for retrieval-style use. Beyond that thin mention, nothing shows dedicated embedding models or an embeddings endpoint. The engine's OpenAI-compatible APIs are listed only for text, speech and vision, and HF model conversion is experimental and never tied to embeddings. Missing for 10: support for dedicated embedding models, a documented embeddings API or serving endpoint, retrieval/vector-search integration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding quality.
